title: Fix a CSV splitter that fails on quoting
prompt: The test suite in this project is failing. Run it, find out why, and fix the source so it passes. Do not change the tests.
notes: The simplest possible code task, and the control for the rest. Correctness is fully determined by the suite: a naive split() fails on quoted commas, doubled quotes, and whitespace inside quotes. Discriminates on whether a config helps at all on work whose success criterion is already explicit — if a config cannot beat baseline here, its gains elsewhere are probably about following instructions rather than about capability.
